name: 霓虹社区会馆

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. A welcoming two-storey cyberpunk community clubhouse: offset flat roof, broad recessed warm amber entrance porch, a physical circular sign frame without lettering, restrained cyan edge strips, graphite walls and rose accent panels. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately

visualReview.notes: 完整门廊、环形招牌、露台与背墙；参考中的暖窗需运行时恢复。
